answer: Require every agent to pass a live personhood check every 30 epochs: a 90-second live session no script can pre-record, renewed to unlock rewards. Each check costs about $4 in proctoring, so a farm of 1,000 fake lagoon identities burns $4,000 per cycle while one honest lotus agent pays only $4 and keeps its full yield. Agents failing twice lose 50% of pending rewards and wait 5 epochs to rejoin. A canyon of stale accounts that never re-verify is swept automatically, but a genuine agent offline while travelling can restore status with one late check for a 10% fee instead of forfeiting its bond.
